create.name: Jean Else
create.bio:
Jean Else is a British mediumship teacher and programme director who spent her working life as a schoolteacher and school administrator before turning to spiritual education. She learned mediumship at first hand from her wife of 24 years, the UK medium Mavis Pittilla, and the two of them built courses, workshops and mentorship programmes together, travelling widely to teach. Jean brought the structure of a professional educator to the work, helping students with the craft of mediumship, its ethics, and public speaking and presentation.

Since Mavis died in 2022, Jean has carried her teaching forward. She directs the Mavis Pittilla-Authorised Teacher Training Programme, runs the Mavis Pittilla Legacy Program with teachers trained by the couple, and has curated an archive of Mavis's recorded lectures and demonstrations. With Suzanne Giesemann she leads The Evidential Mediumship Academy on The Shift Network, a year-long training that combines theory classes, small mentorship circles and supervised practice. Her approach treats mediumship as a discipline that needs time, study and accountability, in the spirit of Mavis's view that a medium should be trained as fully as anyone else who works with people.

courses.title: The Evidential Mediumship Academy - Essentials Training
courses.description: A year-long, application-only training in evidential mediumship led by Jean Else and Suzanne Giesemann with a cohort of Mavis Pittilla-authorised teachers. It combines theory classes, small mentorship circles and practice readings, and ends with a reflective capstone essay. All sessions are held online.

courses.title: The Evidential Mediumship Academy — Skill Building
courses.description: The second-stage academy programme for students building on the Essentials training. A weekly theory class with Jean runs through three learning cycles alongside mentorship circles and practice with Mavis Pittilla-authorised teachers, finishing with a reflective essay.

courses.title: Mavis Pittilla's Legacy Program – 6 Week Introduction
courses.description: A six-week online introduction to Mavis Pittilla's approach to training "the whole medium", run by Jean's Legacy Program. Theory comes from Mavis's recorded lectures and the practical classes are taught by an authorised teacher, with recordings shared in a private group. Longer Level 2 and Level 4 courses run through the year.

free_resources.title: Mavis Pittilla's Pearls: free video tutorials
free_resources.description: A free-to-view selection of short talks by Mavis Pittilla, gathered and published by Jean Else and Annie Gee from Mavis's recorded lectures. Topics include spirit, the soul and mediumship, with further free clips in the "Mavis's Montage" section.

The Legacy Program practical classes are taught by authorised teachers (Joanne Holden, Orla Falvey), with Jean as director.
